source_caption_data.pre_caption: In a close-up, high-angle shot, a yellow crate filled with small orange fruits is positioned in the center of the frame, resting in the middle ground on a green surface covered with leaves. To the left and right of the crate, two lines of identical fruits are arranged horizontally in the middle ground. The video shows these fruits moving sequentially; the fruit on the far left jumps up and into the crate, followed by the fruit on the far right. This alternating movement continues with the next fruits in each line, which also jump into the central crate. A line of Korean text appears at the bottom center and later fades out, while a logo overlay remains stationary in the bottom right corner.
